description: This is a PHP source file defining a class 'Task' within the Opencart admin model setting namespace. It provides CRUD operations and logging functionalities for scheduled tasks, interacting with a database.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: A model class for managing scheduled tasks within the Opencart admin setting module, providing methods for CRUD operations and task logging.

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Creates a new task record in the database, ensuring any existing task with the same code is deleted first.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status and response of an existing task identified by task_id, with validation against allowed statuses.

methods.name: deleteTask
methods.description: Deletes a task from the database based on task_id.

methods.name: deleteTaskByCode
methods.description: Deletes tasks that match a specific code.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Empties the task table, removing all tasks.

methods.name: getTask
methods.description: Retrieves a specific task record by task_id.

methods.name: getTasks
methods.description: Fetches a list of tasks, optionally filtered by code and status, with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalTasks
methods.description: Counts total tasks matching optional filters.

methods.name: addLog
methods.description: Adds a log entry for a task operation with status.

methods.name: getLogs
methods.description: Retrieves a list of task logs with pagination.

methods.name: getTotalLogs
methods.description: Returns the total number of task log entries.
